tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and rows indicate temporal, opposing-step behavior, but the available samples do not identify a quantitative law or distinguish plausible before/after hysteresis mechanisms. A fine trajectory batch is the only listed relevant probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a single-mode Maxwell decay model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows do not fit its simple step-amplitude-times-exponential form; relative decay varies substantially across rows.
Rows span changing inputs and horizons, so these observations do not isolate or identify the OU parameters.
It is explicitly irrelevant to resolving this temporal-law ambiguity.
